name: Predefined Medicaid MAX-TAF Admissions V1 Datasets
description: Outcome-specific Medicaid MAX-TAF inpatient admission products covering all states from 2000-2018. Each outcome has its own folder (e.g., mental_health/) containing qualifying admission files and county/ZCTA yearly and daily admission counts, with the outcome definition encoded in the file name as icdset<N>_dx<positions>_<selection> (e.g., admissions_icdset1_dxall_all_yyyy.parquet). State coverage varies during the 2014-2015 MAX-to-TAF transition.
